# Detached house for sale

> Wonderful and quite unique three bedroomed home enjoying stunning views and offering great privacy. Well appointed property with beautiful gardens this is a once in a generation opportunity to acquire a truly amazing house. Located in a cul-de-sac roadway on the side of the Galtee mountains this exceptional property must be seen to be fully appreciated.
